ingredients.name: Whole Wheat Flour
ingredients.description: Rich in fiber, vitamins, and minerals. Provides sustained energy and supports digestive health.

ingredients.name: Palm Jaggery
ingredients.description: Unrefined sweetener that retains natural minerals and antioxidants. A healthier alternative to white sugar.

ingredients.name: Desi Ghee
ingredients.description: Traditional clarified butter that adds richness and flavor while providing essential fatty acids.

ingredients.name: Besan (Gram Flour)
ingredients.description: Stone-ground chickpea flour that gives the cookie its body and a gently nutty, roasted note.

ingredients.name: Dry Coconut
ingredients.description: Adds natural sweetness and texture while providing medium-chain triglycerides for energy.

ingredients.name: Fennel Seeds
ingredients.description: Aromatic spice that aids digestion and adds a subtle licorice flavor to our cookies.
